Overview

The economics of Blockchain & Digital Trust for Energy & Utilities flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into SCADA / EMS cores without inventing a shadow estate. What makes Energy & Utilities different is not the math; it is the operating context: NERC CIP standards governs the data, grid state governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
